Name: Kath's Wonders and Treats for the Holidays WTH
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/K0bkC3d/Mod-Cover-Logo-WTH.png[/img]
The Holidays have come to the valley and everyone is in good spirits!
From new recipes and items, to new furniture.
Kath's Wonders and Treats for the Holidays hopes to bring you the joy and holiday spirit.[/size]

[size=2]But Kath aren't those too many requirements?
Read through them, some are optional/recommended for the full holiday experience.[/size]

If you really don't want to read through them...
[spoiler]
[u]Needed 100%[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework
[/url](For the furniture folder)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]
(Enable the Artisan Goods and all 3 Extended Packs)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins (EMP)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]

[u]Highly Recommended to enjoy your decorator dreams with a Holiday Catalogue[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]

[u]Highly Recommended for Snowflake Gimmick[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23721]Extra Museum Space[/url] (pre v1.1+)
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34937]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/url] (post v1.1+ - Do It)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]

The rest of the mods mentioned in requirements are optional, but still highly recommended to get this mod's full experience.[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khSpT4Y/compatibility.png[/img]
List of compatibilities~
[spoiler]
[size=2]---- Ingredient Adding Mods ----[/size]
Recipes have been modified to include some ingredients if the following mods are present:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia Artisan Machines[/url]

[size=2]---- Similar Items ----[/size]
They shouldn't conflict due to naming.

[size=2]---- Gift Tastes for NPCs ----[/size]
Context tags have been placed for certain foods.
This include tags used by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSVO[/url]
Some allergen tags that I could think of and match with other mods.

Meat-containing recipes (when [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] is present - overrides the Tofu ingredient) are still considered non-meat if Aimon's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27938]Soy Bean Meats[/url] is present.

[size=2]---- SVE ----[/size]
Yes, it should work with SVE.
No, I am not adding any active support for compatibility.

Custom NPCs should like most items, I made the tastes mostly universal >->[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3vBx7vz/configuration.png[/img]
Make sure to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] so you can check your configs easier~
Read carefully!
[spoiler]
[size=2]---- Mechanics ----[/size]
[b]Snowflake Trail:[/b] A story of sorts to obtaining a mysterious book. Default is 'true'.
(Removed in v1.1+)

[b]Holiday Legendary Fish: [/b]Toggles whether this mod's legendary fish is required for the fishing collection or not. Default 'true'.

[size=2]---- Sound ----[/size]
[b]Jingles Sound:[/b] Add jingle sounds to various things.[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JzvFMLL/what-is-added.png[/img]
[spoiler]
This is a bit messier than usual because scope creep got me bad.[/spoiler]
[size=2][color=#ff0000]Spoilers for the mod ahead, continue with precaution.[/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=2]---- Recipes ----[/size]
Mostly obtained through friendship with the villagers, they may send a mail with their secret recipes at random during close to the winter holidays.
Some recipes found at the Saloon and at Pierre's.

Make sure you've finished the introductions quest to receive some extra mail with delicious food.
(I am sorry to those with lots of NPCs).
[spoiler]
2 Cocoa Pods (from Cornucopia mod), into the mill gives you 2-4 Cocoa Powder.
25 snowflakes (of the same type) in the keg, gives you a Bottled Holiday Spirit.
(Which can be aged in the cask)[/spoiler]

Ingredients required that come from this mod can be found sold at the Saloon and at Pierre's.
Cooked items buff timer may seem crazy but once consumed it will show the time!
(This is due the min and max differences in the buff duration time.)

[size=2]---- Machines ----[/size]
A special machine obtained by Robin.
You need to have read the Power Book :3
For the Collector Bag, Robin sells it during Winter.
(You can process snowflakes into snowballs if you have them enabled)
[spoiler]
10 snowflakes (of the same kind) = 1 to 5 snowballs.
10 snowflakes (of the same kind) = 1 to 2 festive snowballs.
Once added there is a 50% chance it can be either or type of snowball.[/spoiler]

[size=2]---- Furniture ----[/size]
(Must have the optional FF folder)
Obtainable at Robin's for varying prices and availability in winter.
You can purchase a special furniture catalogue if the recommended mod is present.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]
(The optional AT folder is only for recolouring the special furniture catalogue).

[size=2]---- Clothes ----[/size]
Two different hats are obtainable at the hat mouse (one is very rare.)
They might give you a buff if you wear them during winter.
(and if the recommended mod is present!)

Make sure to put the hat on during winter to trigger the buff :3

[size=2]---- Buildings ----[/size]
A special tree can be built from the Wizard.
(You can process snowflakes and snowballs)
[spoiler]
1 snowball = some random snowflakes
20 snowflakes = 1  Bottled Holiday Spirit.[/spoiler]

[size=2]---- Books and Weapons ----[/size]
Two books are available, one for Evelyn's recipes for cookies, and another one for a special buff for winter (found at the bookseller but it is rare.)
(The latter can also be obtained through a crafting recipe after donating snowflakes to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34937]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/url])

A powerful weapon can be obtained too!
(Marlon may rarely have it at a high price OR obtained after donating snowflakes to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34937]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/url]!

And snowballs can be equipped as ammo if the recommended mod is present.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]

[size=2]---- Fish ----[/size]
A legendary fish is available after reaching level 10, however this fish requires special bait!
Only available if [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34937]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/url] is present.
[spoiler]
Special bait can be obtained from the Snow Compactor 3000, from squishing snowflakes into snowballs (and squishing them some more).
(900 snowballs!)
Fish in the mountains whilst it snows using the bait.[/spoiler]

[size=2]---- Snowflakes ----[/size]
If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34937]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/url] is not present, snowflakes will spawn like forage only.
If it present, snowflakes are more easily acquired by carrying an empty bag (sold by robin) during winter.
This can then be opened for snowflakes and snowballs!

Snowflakes can be donated to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34937]Mirin's Museum of Curiosities[/url]!

A special donatable item may fall from the sky during winter!
(With a 0.1% chance)[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MpXMXFh/to-do.png[/img]
Potentially more furniture, I refuse to do chairs.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/XD8h5KT/special-thanks-and-recommendations.png[/img]
[size=2]Special thanks to the framework mod authors, you make me want to collect them all ><[/size]
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/745980]Caranud[/url] for the French Translation!
